This is a "REQUEST FOR INFORMATION" only. This Sources Sought Notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes. It is neither a solicitation announcement nor a request for proposals or quotes and does not obligate the Government to award a contract. Requests for a solicitation will not receive a response. Responses to this Sources Sought notice must be in writing. 

The Syracuse VA Medical Center has a requirement for construction services to perform the replacement of three institutional boiler exhaust stacks located at the ROME Community Based Outpatient Clinic (CBOC) 125 Brookley Road #510, Rome NY 13441. The project shall include:
Demolition of the three existing boiler exhaust stacks
Abatement of known and unknown asbestos and other potential hazardous materials 
Installation/construction of three new replacement exhaust stacks, supporting structural steel tower and foundation. Installation involves structural steel fabrication that requires 3rd party NYS special inspection during construction.

Services shall be performed by a general contractor with experience and expertise in the demolition and construction/installation of institutional boiler exhaust stacks and supporting structural steel tower.

The NAICS Code is 238220    Plumbing, Heating, and Air-Conditioning Contractors", with a size standard of $19M. All responsible sources may submit a capability statement which shall be considered by the Syracuse VA Medical Center. This is not a solicitation. If there is sufficient interest, a solicitation shall be posted on SAM.gov. Please send all inquiries to: Michael.Spivack@va.gov by 12:00 EST March 17th, 2026. Phone calls will not be accepted.
